Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
This is a petition seeking quashing of the FIR No. 191/2021 dated 13.07.2021 registered under Section 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Maidan Garhi.
It is stated by Mr. Vinay, learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is the brother-in-law of the complainant.
He has never resided in the same house and the allegations in the FIR are of a general and vague character.
The petitioner has been roped in only out of vindictiveness and vendetta.
For the said reasons, issue notice to the respondent No.2 on the petitioner taking steps within 1 week from today.

sentences.text: The notice is returnable on 17.07.2023.
This is an application seeking stay of proceedings vis-a-vis the petitioner.

Even though there are some allegations in the FIR regarding demand of dowry by the petitioner, in the statement under Section 164 Cr.PC of the complainant, there are no allegations of demand of dowry against the petitioner.
In addition, the petitioner also does not reside at the matrimonial home of the complainant as he is staying at Kanti Nagar Extension, East Delhi.
The petitioner is the husband of the sister of the complainants husband.
Prima facie the allegations in the FIR seem to be based out of vindictiveness and vendetta.

For the said reasons, till the next date of hearing, proceedings against the petitioner in the FIR No.
191/2021 dated 13.07.2021 registered under Section 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Maidan Garhi shall remain stayed.
